QUOTE: "Define it in the public header for its module, `include/mbedtls/<module>.h`. Write `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>  -0x…` with a Doxygen description... Regenerate `library/error.c`... Nobody edits `error.c` by hand."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the Doxygen-documented #define to the public header and regenerate error.c, and it says error.c is never hand-edited.
